correctness.rationale: The 4D zonotope minor identity gives exact volume polynomials affine in the special scale; the segment scaling expansion reduces the sign of every defect to a quadratic F_{u,v}. All 45 unordered direction pairs are exhaustively enumerated, with an explicit integer coefficient table: the sole polynomial with negative linear coefficient is 4t(t-2); every other polynomial has nonnegative constant and linear terms and strictly positive quadratic coefficient. This analytically proves continuum signs, including exactly eight zero constants at t=0. The embedded standard-library checker independently reconstructs every table entry from raw integer minors, and 360 volume expressions were separately cross-checked using symbolic determinants. No inference from finite samples to infinitely many parameters.

value.rationale: The finite set is canonical, not arbitrary: it is all ten elementary columns I4 union D4 in the Oxley–Walsh 2-modular template where a recent counterexample was discovered. Establishing unique failure among all 45 unordered pairs, for every positive pair of segment lengths and every nonnegative scale, is a natural complete local Rayleigh classification. It shows the obstruction is directionally isolated in the standard template and provides a sharp sign/equality benchmark in a dimension/codegree regime where general positivity fails; the previously known one-pair phase itself is not counted as new value.
